jobs.title: Sr Program Manager - 800G & 1.6T OSFP Optical Transceivers
jobs.description:
Job Req ID: 30379

About Supermicro:

Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the #5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven SR Program Manager to lead the development, qualification, release, and deployment of next-generation 800G and 1.6T OSFP optical transceiver products for AI infrastructure, hyperscale cloud data centers, and high-performance networking applications.

The successful candidate will drive cross-functional hardware and software programs from concept through production, coordinating engineering, firmware, software, validation, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and customer-facing teams. This role requires strong technical program management expertise, experience managing complex product releases, and a solid understanding of optical networking technologies.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Program Leadership

- Lead end-to-end program execution for 800G and 1.6T OSFP optical transceiver products from concept through volume production.

- Develop and maintain integrated program plans, schedules, milestones, budgets, and resource allocations.

- Drive alignment across cross-functional teams including optics, electrical, mechanical, firmware, software, validation, operations, quality, and supply chain.

- Manage program risks, dependencies, and critical path activities while ensuring timely delivery of key milestones.

- Provide executive-level status reporting, program reviews, and escalation management.

- Establish and drive program governance processes, metrics, and best practices.

Hardware & Software Product Release Management

- Manage end-to-end hardware and software product release cycles for optical transceiver products.

- Coordinate release readiness activities across engineering, validation, manufacturing, operations, and customer support teams.

- Track feature readiness, bug resolution, firmware/software releases, qualification status, interoperability testing, and customer commitments.

- Drive release schedules and ensure alignment between hardware milestones and software/firmware deliverables.

- Lead release reviews and develop go-to-market and deployment readiness plans.

- Ensure product releases meet quality, reliability, performance, and customer requirements.

Optical Transceiver Product Development

- Manage New Product Introduction (NPI) programs for:

- 800G OSFP DR8, 2xDR4, FR4, and LR4 modules

- 1.6T OSFP and OSFP-XD optical transceivers

- PAM4-based high-speed optical interconnect solutions

- Drive engineering development through EVT, DVT, PVT, qualification, customer sampling, and production ramps.

- Coordinate design reviews, validation activities, and manufacturing readiness reviews.

- Ensure compliance with industry standards, customer specifications, and regulatory requirements.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

- Partner closely with strategic customers to ensure successful product qualification and deployment.

- Support technical reviews, roadmap discussions, and customer escalations.

- Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Operations, and Executive Leadership to align priorities and expectations.

- Act as the primary program interface between internal teams and external stakeholders.

Manufacturing & Supply Chain Management

- Drive manufacturing readiness and production ramp activities.

- Coordinate with contract manufacturers, suppliers, and component vendors to ensure timely delivery of critical materials.

- Monitor supply chain risks, lead times, and capacity constraints.

- Support cost reduction initiatives and yield improvement programs.

- Ensure manufacturing quality and reliability objectives are achieved.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or related technical field.

- 8+ years of Program Management experience in optical networking, telecommunications, semiconductor, networking hardware, or data center infrastructure industries.

- Demonstrated success managing complex cross-functional hardware development programs.

- Experience managing product lifecycles from concept through production.

- Strong project planning, risk management, and stakeholder communication skills.

- Proven ability to influence and drive alignment across global organizations.

- Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing 800G and/or 1.6T optical transceiver product development programs.

- Deep understanding of OSFP and OSFP-XD architectures and high-speed optical interconnect technologies.

- Proven experience managing hardware and software product releases for networking, optical communications, semiconductor, or data center products.

- Experience coordinating firmware, software, and hardware development cycles within NPI and product lifecycle management processes.

- Strong knowledge of hyperscale cloud infrastructure and AI networking environments.

- Experience working directly with hyperscale customers including Microsoft, Meta, Amazon, Google, or equivalent cloud service providers.

- PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, or equivalent certification.

- MBA or Master's degree in Engineering or related discipline preferred.

Salary Range

$165,000 - $185,000

The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills, years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus and equity award programs.

jobs.title: Program Manager - Infrastructure/Tools
jobs.description:
Job Req ID: 29643

About Supermicro:

Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the #5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.

Job Summary:

Supermicro is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Program Manager - Infrastructure/Tools to lead and manage critical internal tools and marketing operations within the Marketing Department. This role will define requirements and drive the development of internal tools and processes — including employee-facing platforms (internal software, communication tools, marketing portal), cross-functional tools (project management, analytics, data platforms), and infrastructure/operational products that serve other teams internally. The role will also manage sales tool enhancements, oversee ISO documentation, and maintain the Marketing Department Handbook. The ideal candidate will be proactive, process-driven, and comfortable collaborating across cross-functional teams, including with software developers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Internal Tools & Process Engineering

- Define requirements and drive the development of internal tools and processes to improve marketing and sales efficiency.

- Lead process reengineering initiatives to optimize marketing and sales workflows.

- Identify bottlenecks and implement best-practice improvements across marketing operations.

- Focus on employee-facing tools and platforms (internal software, communication tools, marketing portal), cross-functional tools (project management, analytics, data platforms), and infrastructure/operational products that serve other teams internally.

Sales Tool Enhancement

- Manage the sales tool enhancement process, including gathering requirements from sales and marketing stakeholders.

- Develop detailed functional specifications and user stories.

- Interface with software developers and technical teams to prioritize, track, and implement enhancements.

- Ensure timely delivery and testing of improvements to sales tools and platforms.

ISO Documentation & Compliance

- Review, update, and maintain Work Instruction Procedures (WIPs) for ISO compliance (e.g., ISO 9001).

- Create new WIPs as required by the ISO team across marketing functions, including events, web, product samples, and collateral.

- Lead pFMEA (Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) activities and track department-level KPIs to support continuous improvement and ISO compliance for the Marketing Department.

- Prepare required documents and support external ISO audit processes.

- Coordinate with marketing teams to ensure documented procedures are current and accurate.

Marketing SOP Handbook Management

- Own and maintain the Marketing Department’s SOP handbook.

- Work closely with team leads across creative, communications, social media, advertising, web, product marketing, and events to document and refine standard processes.

- Ensure SOP content is clear, consistent, and aligned with overall brand and compliance standards.

Additional Responsibilities

- Develop and execute channel marketing strategies and activities to support partner enablement and joint go-to-market efforts.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product Marketing, Engineering, Operations, Legal, and Finance teams to align programs with business objectives.

- Monitor program performance, generate insights and reports, and recommend enhancements for greater efficiency and impact.

- Support additional marketing operations and program initiatives as required.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field. Candidates with a Marketing or Business degree and strong process engineering experience will also be considered.

- 5 - 8 years of experience in product management, process engineering, program management, or operations roles, ideally in the server, storage, AI, or hardware industry.

- Strong background in process engineering, reengineering workflows, and implementing operational improvements.

- Hands-on technical background with servers, components (CPUs, memory, storage), or data center environments is strongly preferred.

- Proven experience defining requirements, driving internal tool and process development, managing operational programs, compliance processes (e.g., ISO), and working with software development teams.

- Strong project management and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts and data insights for both internal teams and external partners.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, CRM systems (HubSpot preferred), and program management platforms.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while managing multiple priorities.

Preferred Skills

- Direct experience with technical customer programs or hardware procurement.

- Background in channel marketing in the IT/server/AI hardware space.

- Knowledge of ISO 9001 or similar quality management systems.

- Understanding of high-performance computing, AI systems, or data center solutions.

Salary Range

$100,000 - $125,000
